page_notes_zh.1: 需付中央及UCI學雜費、只ACP或ASAP。舊15%學雜費折扣＝85折，不是所有食宿保險折扣，實額依校方。含12學分，超修另繳不是禁止。大學二年級以上，iBT80/IELTS6.5/TOEIC685，原件GAP3.0拼法保留不改GPA。秋9–12月春3–6月未年。p1要求purchasecompulsoryhealthinsurance與p2可自備合格保單差異保留。
page_notes_zh.2: 原生僅中文標題，英文排除費用清單是影像。未含往返機票、機場接送LAX90USD/SNA50USD須先安排、醫保UCI585USD/quarter或自備合要求保單、SEVIS/F1簽證、食宿、課本、付費活動、個人支出。585按quarter不是semester或當期價格，不做完整總預算／硬性購買UCI保單。

page_transcriptions.text:
Not Included in the Price
Airfare to/from home country
Airport Pick-up [but available with advance arrangement for $90 from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), $50 from John Wayne-Orange County Airport (SNA)]

SEVIS and F-1 Visa fees
Housing (rent) and meals
Textbooks
Fee-based activities and excursions
All other personal expenses
